content.outro: The toll bar stands up at the head of Harrow Gap, and the road runs on into the valley. Nobody has paid at the gap for a long time, and today nobody did.
content.premise: The toll wardens left Harrow Gap a generation ago and took nothing with them. The road through the gap is free now, but the strongrooms in its walls are still set the way the wardens left them, and the toll bar at the head of the pass is still down.
content.theme: A walled pass where every strongroom of the old toll is still trapped, and a lever beside each says how to make it safe.
content.title: The Toll Road
